**Gateway 503 outage — on-call handoff**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, deployed by a.novak, `02:12:00Z`–`02:14:00Z`) shipped config generation 119, flipping `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. Each request started grabbing its own connection instead of sharing the pool. The pool (size 20) saturated within 30 seconds.

**Impact window:** `02:14:18.972Z` (first `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED` 503) through at least `03:59:27.974Z`, the last line in the log. Still ongoing when the log ends. Waiting queue grew from 13 to over 70 requests over that span. Affected routes: `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/catalog/search`, `/v1/orders`.

**Not affected:** worker fleet. `worker.log` shows every job finishing ok across the same window.

**Rollback:** revert `dep-4471`.
